sms.title: Configure an SMS provider
sms.description: Configure an SMS provider for notifications and verification codes. Send a test message after saving to verify the configuration.

tenant.title: Create tenants and tenant administrators
tenant.description: A tenant is an individual or organization that owns or manages devices and assets. Create a tenant, then add administrators to manage its devices, assets, customers and dashboards.

mail.title: Configure an outgoing mail server
mail.description: Configure outgoing mail for account activation, password resets and notifications. Send a test email from settings after saving the configuration.

twoFactor.title: Configure two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Configure authentication providers and verification policies to add an extra layer of protection for platform users.

oauth.title: Configure OAuth 2
oauth.description: Add an OAuth 2 client and associate it with a domain to allow users to sign in through an external identity provider.

device.title: Create a device
device.description: Add your first device, select its profile and enter a name. The platform will generate connection credentials for the device.

connect.title: Connect a device
connect.description: Select a device in the device list and open its connectivity instructions. Use its credentials to publish telemetry over MQTT, HTTP or CoAP.

dashboard.title: Create a dashboard
dashboard.description: Create dashboards to organize and display telemetry from devices and assets. Manage dashboards and customer assignments from the dashboard list.

rule.title: Configure alarm rules
rule.description: Define trigger conditions, severity and clear conditions, for example to raise an alarm when a device temperature exceeds a threshold.

alarm.title: Create an alarm
alarm.description: Publish telemetry that meets an alarm rule's conditions. When the rule triggers, view, acknowledge or clear the alarm from the alarm list.

customer.title: Create a customer and share dashboards
customer.description: Create a customer and assign devices and dashboards. Customer users can only access their assigned resources; other customers' data remains hidden.
